topic: DP-3T: A Privacy-Preserving Approach to Contact Tracing
target_audience: University Students (Computer Science, Public Health, or related fields)

sections.title: The Challenge: Contact Tracing and Privacy
lecture_lines: Contact tracing is crucial for controlling outbreaks.
Digital solutions can also compromise data.
A new approach is needed for privacy.
animations: FadeIn the text 'Need for a New Solution'

sections.title: The Technology: Bluetooth & Cryptographic Keys
lecture_lines: When diagnosed, you report to the server.

sections.title: How It Works: Reporting and Infection Status
lecture_lines: Your phone checks against reported keys.
It alerts you if you were exposed.
Privacy is maintained throughout the process.

sections.title: The Privacy Guarantee: Data Minimization and Anonymity
lecture_lines: This balances public health and privacy.

sections.title: DP-3T in Action: Real-World Applications & Future
lecture_lines: It's a model for future tracing apps.
